title: Courses
body:
Learn to build the things we sell. Taught by designers who actually do the work.

Pick a course below for what it covers and what it costs.

options.label: Livery Design
options.title: Livery Design
options.content:
Template setup and safe zones, decals and stripes, matching real agency styles, exporting at the right resolution.

**4 sessions** · price set per intake · instructor assigned on signup

options.label: Graphics & Branding
options.title: Graphics & Branding
options.content:
Composition and hierarchy, type pairing, colour that survives dark mode, building a brand kit that stays consistent.

**5 sessions** · price set per intake · instructor assigned on signup

options.label: Discord Development
options.title: Discord Development
options.content:
Server architecture and permissions, Components V2 panels, building a bot in discord.py, hosting it so it stays up.

**6 sessions** · price set per intake · instructor assigned on signup

options.label: ELS Patterns
options.title: ELS Patterns
options.content:
Pattern syntax and timing, realistic light behaviour, per-vehicle config, testing and fixing what looks wrong.

**3 sessions** · price set per intake · instructor assigned on signup
